tests.name: adapts both platforms with exact recommendation and post-model parity
preserves acquisition time, raw model clock and separate derived frame time
correct derived models may update an existing row without moving its frozen target
two distinct source receipts confirm correct target with original source time
archived or published data without explicit frame receipts is rejected
future and pre-cycle receipts are rejected
processing completion cannot precede cycle start
freshness remains bounded when processing is delayed
cached read cannot be restamped into a new sequence-less cycle
same source timestamp cannot be presented as a newer read
an identical serialized retry is idempotent even with reordered object keys
changed payload under reused cycle ID is rejected
two different frames cannot silently share the engine processing timestamp
backwards cycle is rejected
fixture outputs cannot later be mixed with a captured stream
cross-platform receipt cannot be relabeled by adapter
mutated recommendation fails exact parity rather than adjusting it
post-update EMA must match unchanged production function
post-update model supplied as pre-update input is rejected
unobserved retained models keep raw clock and do not become new model evidence
ambiguous name+rating from two IDs is rejected before model routing
bad second platform cannot commit first platform or mutate previous state
legacy closed and open rows remain unchanged and excluded
future legacy snapshot cannot leak into a historical replay
